modelIdentification.name: pyjevsim-object-tracking
modelIdentification.description: Reference FOM for the time-managed object-tracking example. One object class (Vehicle) with two attributes (Position, Speed) updated by a producer federate at each TimeAdvanceGrant. Tracker federates subscribe and receive the reflects via the pysdk events stream → pyjevsim-style external_transition.

objectClass.name: Vehicle
objectClass.semantics: A moving vehicle whose Position and Speed are updated periodically. Updates are timestamped (TSO delivery) so subscribers receive them in logical-time order coordinated by rtid's TimeService.

attribute.name: Position
attribute.semantics: Scalar position along a 1-D track. Encoded as 8-byte big-endian IEEE-754 double.
